title: The equations of general Hassett maximal cubic fourfolds
summary: In this note, we discuss Hassett maximal cubic fourfolds and construct an explicit irreducible component of maximal dimension sixteen of the locus $\mathcal{Z}$ of Hassett maximal cubic fourfolds. We utilize algebraic and arithmetic methods to analyze the associated lattice of these fourfolds. % By studying general integral quadratic forms and proving the ADC property for a specific ternary form, we demonstrate that the primitive image of our lattice spans the entire Hassett subset, confirming the Hassett maximality of the cubic fourfolds we describe.
